verdict.rationale: The engine runtime is open source under the MIT license (npm 2.22.2), so shipped games built on it cannot structurally be repriced retroactively. The plans page lists subscription features such as self-hosting downloads and free app hosting, but says nothing about how stable pricing has been over time. missing for 10: documented pricing/license history, explicit no-retroactive-change or no-runtime-fee policy, independent corroboration of stable terms over time, clarity on Editor subscription term stability.
